environment.database: Local PostgreSQL 18.6 over TCP on loopback; application CRUD used the restricted runtime login.
environment.api: Real Node backend process using the browser test database.
environment.frontend: Real Next.js app from the careerprep-frontend worktree.
environment.auth_storage: Local HTTP stand-in for Supabase Auth and Storage; no hosted Supabase credentials or data.
environment.fixtures: Two synthetic .example.test users and a private local resumes bucket.

tests.title: desktop CRUD, two-user isolation, cross-tab switch, and file cleanup use real PostgreSQL
database readiness is marked Unavailable when the /ready endpoint returns an error

assertions.name: User A authenticated through the local Auth REST stand-in and reached the real API.
Readable PDF upload persisted in PostgreSQL with a matching local Storage entry.
Title edit was committed to PostgreSQL.
Reload restored the renamed PDF; original PDF and DOCX downloads matched their uploaded readable fixtures byte-for-byte.
A second tab signed out A and signed in as B without reloading the first tab; A data disappeared and B received 404 for both A resumes.
Switching the shared session back to A restored A’s persisted resume list.
Delete removed both PostgreSQL resume rows, storage metadata rows, local objects, and completed both cleanup tasks.
The UI displayed Unavailable for a failing /ready probe; the real runtime DB /ready endpoint returned 200.
